Picked 17 Oct 2026 so no review appears on two masterclass pages.

reviews.program: Learn The Art of Cinematic Sounds Ft. Pradeep G
reviews.name: Uppuluri S.
reviews.text: I really enjoyed how today’s session on sound designing combined creativity with practical learning. I loved exploring how different sounds can completely change the mood and impact of a scene. The hands-on examples and demonstrations made it easier to understand concepts like layering, effects, and sound editing. It was engaging, insightful, and gave me a new perspective on how important sound is in storytelling.

reviews.text: Overall it was great. Personally I learnt a very new things where I had zero knowledge of film making, behind the camera and about the camera. Angles, shots, sences, sound.. everything. It was amazing to gain these kinds of knowledge about cinema. Thank you so much level up learning. Please do more sessions.
